data.description:
## Testing Mode: UPDATE

Register the hook and update supporting files. Depends on 5bf9-b5e0-a60f-4a18 (GREEN implementation).

## Changes

### .pre-commit-config.yaml
Add session-merge-only-check hook after the sprint-trailer-check hook:
```yaml
      - id: session-merge-only-check
        name: Session Worktree Merge-Only Check (10s timeout)
        entry: ./plugins/dso/scripts/pre-commit-wrapper.sh session-merge-only-check 10 "plugins/dso/scripts/check-session-merge-only.sh"
        language: system
        pass_filenames: false
        always_run: true
        stages: [pre-commit]
```
Note: No env: block — DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE inherited from shell.

### .gitignore
Add .sprint-active to the 'Checkpoint runtime artifacts' section:
```
# Sprint-active marker file (created by Phase A, removed by Phase I, never committed)
.sprint-active
```

### .test-index
Add row:
```
plugins/dso/scripts/check-session-merge-only.sh | tests/hooks/test-check-session-merge-only.sh [RED: f410-513a-b3e7-43ed]
```

## File Impact
- .pre-commit-config.yaml (modify)
- .gitignore (modify)
- .test-index (modify)
